# Rust PNG interoperability fixture

`decoded.png` and `decoded.render.json` were generated by the Rust writer in
`crates/radiust-core/examples/rust_png_fixture.rs`.

Regenerate them from the repository root with:

```bash
CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true cargo run --locked -p radiust-core --example rust_png_fixture -- tests/fixtures/rust-migration/output/png/decoded.png
```

`tests/contract/test_rust_png_readback.py` reads both artifacts independently
with Pillow and Python's JSON parser.
